main_text.p: Fannivs. facile id quidem fuit, iuftiti-am iuftiffimo viro defendere. Scaevola. Quid amicitiam? nonne facile ei erit, qui obeam fumma fide, conftantia, iuftitiaq; feruatam, maximam ceperit gloriam? Laelivs. vim hoc quidem eftafferre[?]. Quid enim refert qua me ratione cogatis? Cogitis certè: ftudiis enim generorum, præfertim in re bona, cum difficile eft, tum ne æquû quidem obfiftere. Sæpiffime igitur mihi de amicitia cogitanti, maxime illud confiderandum videri folet, num propter imbecillitatem, atq; inopiam defideranda fit amicitia: ut in dandis, recipiendisq; meritis, quod quifq; minus per fe poffet, id acciperet ab alio viciffimq; redderet: an effet hoc quidem proprium amicitiæ, fed antiquior, & pulchrior, & magis à natura ipfa profecta alia caufa effet. Amor enim (ex quo amicitia eft nominata) princeps eft ad benevolentiam coniungendam. Nam utilitates quidem etiam ab iis percipientur fæpe, qui fimulatione amicitiæ coluntur, & obferuantur caufa temporis.

page.notes: The page number prints as "3S", read as 38. Line-end "tempo-" is followed on the last line by "ris." at the right, the rest of "temporis"; "In" beside it is the catchword. The speaker names (Fannivs, Scaevola, Laelivs) are set in small capitals in the text and are kept inline, not as headings. Doubtful: "eftafferre[?]" (the printed word after "vim hoc quidem" is hard to read with certainty). The word "æquû" keeps its printed macron-u form.
